2-s79.condition: Unit 7, Step 3, упр. 2, с. 79. Прочитай словосочетания и скажи, что Эмма делала и чего не делала два дня назад.
steps: Emma didn't work in the garage, she worked in the garden. She didn't phone her parents, she phoned her friends. She didn't wash the dishes, she washed cups and mugs. She didn't cook lunch, she cooked breakfast. She didn't ask questions, she answered them.
2-s79.answer: Emma didn't …, she … — пары противоположных действий (garage / garden, parents / friends, dishes / cups, lunch / breakfast).

3-s79.condition: Unit 7, Step 3, упр. 3, с. 79. В парах составьте вопросы в Past Simple и ответьте на них.
steps: Did you play tennis yesterday? — Yes, I did. Did you clean your room last weekend? — No, I didn't. Did you watch TV last night? — Yes, I did.
3-s79.answer: Did you …? — Yes, I did / No, I didn't.

4-s80.condition: Unit 7, Step 3, упр. 4, с. 80. Составь вопросы о том, как Джон провёл выходные (общие и специальные).
steps: I. Were you at home, John? Did you help your parents? Did you watch television? Did you walk the dog?
II. Where did you play tennis, John? When did you clean your room? What did you wash? Who did you phone? How many questions did you answer?
4-s80.answer: Общие: Were you…? Did you…? Специальные: Where / When / What / Who / How many + did you…?

5-s80.condition: Unit 7, Step 3, упр. 5, с. 80. A) Послушай и повтори новые слова. B) Повтори словосочетания и предложения с ними.
steps: decide — решать; invite — приглашать; join — присоединяться; talk — разговаривать; travel — путешествовать; try — пытаться; visit — навещать.
decide to go, invite friends, join us, talk to the teacher, travel by train, try to help, visit granny.
5-s80.answer: decide, invite, join, talk, travel, try, visit — с переводом и словосочетаниями.

6-s81.condition: Unit 7, Step 3, упр. 6, с. 81. Скажи, что Джон Баркер делал на прошлой неделе, используя новые слова.
steps: Last week John visited his cousin Mary and his friend Sid. He invited Lucy, Victor and Sid to his birthday. He joined his friends in the park. He talked to his teacher. He travelled to London by train. He tried to cook dinner.
6-s81.answer: Last week John visited…, invited…, joined…, talked to…, travelled…, tried to…

7-s82.condition: Unit 7, Step 3, упр. 7, с. 82. A) Скажи, что эти люди решили делать в конце недели. B) Скажи, что они постарались сделать в начале следующей недели.
steps: A) Mark decided to go to the park. Fred decided to ride his bike. Jim and Mary decided to watch television. Polly decided to play tennis. Emma and Kate decided to cook dinner. The Browns decided to travel by bus.

B) Mark tried to cook a nice dinner. Fred tried to talk on the phone with his friend. Jim and Mary tried to see the new film. Polly tried to take a tennis lesson. Emma and Kate tried to visit the doctor. The Browns tried to talk to their son's teacher.
7-s82.answer: A) … decided to + глагол. B) … tried to + глагол.

8-s83.condition: Unit 7, Step 3, упр. 8, с. 83. Домашнее задание: выполни упр. 1–4 рабочей тетради.
steps: РТ 1 (аудио): The boy's name was Victor. His friends invited him to Moscow last summer. Yes, his cousins decided to join them. They went by train. Yes, they liked Moscow.
РТ 2: прописываем decide, invite, join, talk, travel, try, visit.
РТ 3: I travelled by bus yesterday, by car last weekend, by plane last summer, by train yesterday evening, by ship on Sunday.
РТ 4: I talked to my teacher yesterday morning. I travelled to Spain last summer. I visited my grandparents last month. I invited my best friend to my birthday party.
8-s83.answer: РТ 1: ответы о поездке Виктора в Москву. РТ 3: travelled by bus / car / plane / train / ship. РТ 4: talked, travelled, visited, invited + когда.

steps: Настоящее: 1, 4, 6, 7. Прошедшее: 2, 3, 5, 8.

3-s85.condition: Unit 7, Step 4, упр. 3, с. 85. Закончи предложения, подобрав вопросительные слова.
3-s85.answer: c, g, e, a, f, b, d

4-s86.condition: Unit 7, Step 4, упр. 4, с. 86. A) Скажи, сколько лет исполнится ребятам (will be). B) Скажи, какая будет погода (It will be …).
steps: A) Melissa will be fifteen in March. Bob will be six in July. Kate will be nine in April. Colin will be seventeen in August. Sara will be one in June. Tim will be seven in July. Andrew will be fourteen in November. Phil will be ten in December.
B) It will be hot in Spain. It will be foggy in France. It will be rainy in Moscow. It will be windy in Florida. It will be cloudy in Scotland. It will be snowy in Minsk. It will be cold in Finland.
4-s86.answer: A) … will be + возраст + in + месяц. B) It will be hot / foggy / rainy / windy / cloudy / snowy / cold in …

5-s87.condition: Unit 7, Step 4, упр. 5, с. 87. Скажи, куда не поедут эти люди (won't go).
steps: Scarlet won't go to London. Nick won't go to Florida. Sally won't go to Paris. Jenny won't go to Rome. Bob won't go to Moscow. Rick won't go to Spain. Alex won't go to Minsk. Jane won't go to Glasgow.
5-s87.answer: … won't go to London / Florida / Paris / Rome / Moscow / Spain / Minsk / Glasgow

6-s87.condition: Unit 7, Step 4, упр. 6, с. 87. A) Послушай и прочитай диалоги, составь свои по образцу. B) Разыграй их.
steps: A: Will you go to Paris, Jane? — B: Yes, I will. — A: When will you go there? — B: I think I'll be in Paris in June.
A: Will you go to Madrid? — B: Yes, I will. — A: When? — B: In August. A: Will you go to Moscow? — B: Yes, in December.
6-s87.answer: Will you go to …? — Yes, I will. When will you go there? — I think I'll be in … in …

7-s88.condition: Unit 7, Step 4, упр. 7, с. 88. Ответь на вопросы о завтрашнем дне (Future Simple).
steps: I will get up, have breakfast and go to school. I will have toast, eggs and yoghurt for breakfast. I will meet my classmates. I will have five lessons. I will go to the swimming pool after school. I will do my homework. I will read a book and have dinner in the evening. I will go to bed at 10.
7-s88.answer: Ответы с I will: get up, have breakfast, go to school, five lessons, swimming pool, homework, dinner, go to bed.

8-s88.condition: Unit 7, Step 4, упр. 8, с. 88. Домашнее задание: выполни упр. 1–5 рабочей тетради.
steps: РТ 1 (аудио): summer, winter, autumn.
РТ 2: прописываем слова.
РТ 3: What, Where, Who, When.
РТ 4: get, gets; will have, will have; played, watched; am reading.
РТ 5 (20 глаголов): get, help, ride, watch, go, have, see, eat, be, show, enjoy, travel, visit, invite, join, talk, try, decide, cook, play.
8-s88.answer: РТ 1: summer, winter, autumn. РТ 3: What, Where, Who, When. РТ 4: get/gets, will have, played/watched, am reading. РТ 5: 20 глаголов.

1-s88.condition: Unit 7, Step 5, упр. 1, с. 88. Прослушай запись и скажи, о будущем или о настоящем идёт речь.
steps: 1 — настоящее (they are talking on the phone); 2 — будущее (the boy will try hard); 3 — будущее (the children will show you the gym); 4 — настоящее (the sun shines brightly in summer); далее по записи.
1-s88.answer: Настоящее — 1, 4; будущее — 2, 3 (и далее по записи: will → будущее, Present Simple/Continuous → настоящее).

2-s89.condition: Unit 7, Step 5, упр. 2, с. 89. A) Представь, как пройдёт твой следующий день рождения. B) Ответь на вопросы о празднике в честь окончания учебного года.
steps: A) I'll have my birthday party at home. I'll invite my friends. Before the party I'll help my parents to cook. We'll eat ice cream and drink lemonade. We'll play a lot of games. I'll have wonderful presents. I'll be very happy.
B) Yes, I will. We will have the party on Friday at school. We will invite our teachers. We will eat pizza and drink juice. We will listen to music and dance. Yes, we will.
2-s89.answer: A) Рассказ с I'll / we'll о дне рождения. B) Ответы Yes, I will / We will … about the party.

3-s90.condition: Unit 7, Step 5, упр. 3, с. 90. A) Прослушай и прочитай новые слова. B) Прочитай предложения с ними.
steps: country — страна; holiday — каникулы, отпуск; next — следующий; people — люди; place — место; soon — скоро; tomorrow — завтра.
a big country, many countries; long summer holidays; next Sunday; a lot of people; an interesting place; see you soon; tomorrow morning.
3-s90.answer: country, holiday, next, people, place, soon, tomorrow — с переводом и примерами.

4-s91.condition: Unit 7, Step 5, упр. 4, с. 91. Заполни пропуски словами из таблицы.
steps: country, next, holiday, places, people, soon, tomorrow.
4-s91.answer: country, next, holiday, places, people, soon, tomorrow

5-s92.condition: Unit 7, Step 5, упр. 5, с. 92. Посмотри на картинки и скажи, что собираются делать люди (be going to).
steps: The children are going to swim. The boy is going to drink some milk. The girls are going to dance. The girl is going to clean the room. The girl is going to write. The boys are going to play football. The boy is going to cook.
5-s92.answer: … is / are going to swim / drink milk / dance / clean the room / write / play football / cook

6-s93.condition: Unit 7, Step 5, упр. 6, с. 93. Познакомься с правилом употребления конструкции be going to.
steps: be going to + глагол — «собираться что-то сделать» (планы на ближайшее будущее).
Утверждение: I am going to read. He is going to play. They are going to swim.
Вопрос: Are you going to read? Is he going to play? Отрицание: I am not going to read. He isn't going to play.
6-s93.answer: am / is / are + going to + глагол — «собираться сделать»: I am going to read; Are you going to swim?; He isn't going to cook.

7-s93.condition: Unit 7, Step 5, упр. 7, с. 93. Ответь на вопросы о своих планах на лето (Are you going to…?).
steps: Are you going to swim in summer? — Yes, I am. Are you going to play with your friends? — No, I'm not. Are you going to travel? — Yes, I am. Are you going to visit your grandparents? — Yes, I am.
7-s93.answer: Are you going to …? — Yes, I am / No, I'm not.

8-s94.condition: Unit 7, Step 5, упр. 8, с. 94. Домашнее задание: выполни упр. 1–5 рабочей тетради.
steps: РТ 1 (аудио): country, tomorrow, next, holidays, people, place, soon.
РТ 2: Next Sunday I will draw a picture / watch a film / read a book / play games with my friends / walk my dog.
РТ 3: Tomorrow I won't cook dinner / do my homework / tidy my room / bake a cake / go shopping.
РТ 4: David is going to close the window, wash the floor, do the dishes, water the plant.
РТ 5: прописываем country, holiday, next, people, place, soon, tomorrow.
8-s94.answer: РТ 1: новые слова по записи. РТ 2: пять планов с will. РТ 3: пять предложений с won't. РТ 4: David is going to… РТ 5: слова.

steps: 1. was, played, watched, enjoyed. 2. travel, see, meet, likes, likes, go, are.
3. will be, will be, will have, will cook, will put, will look, will come, will give.

5-s97.condition: Unit 7, Step 6, упр. 5, с. 97. A) Прочитай и прослушай текст, найди предложения с be going to. B) Определи, какие утверждения верны, неверны или не упомянуты.
steps: A) She is going to take her to see a lot of interesting places. They are going to walk the streets of Moscow. She is going to take her friend to the cinema. They are going to visit her friends soon.
B) False, True, Not stated, True, Not stated, True, True, Not stated, True.

6-s98.condition: Unit 7, Step 6, упр. 6, с. 98. Прослушай и повтори рифмовку What are you going to do tonight?
steps: Рифмовка на конструкцию be going to: What are you going to do tonight? — I am going to meet my friend. I'd like to talk to her in the garden — the best place.
6-s98.answer: Рифмовка с вопросом What are you going to do tonight? и ответом I am going to…; учим по учебнику.

steps: РТ 2: I am going to go to the shop on Monday, swim on Tuesday, play with friends on Wednesday, help my parents on Thursday, make presents on Friday.

5-s103.condition: Unit 7, Step 7, упр. 5, с. 103. Ответь на вопросы о своих летних каникулах.
steps: Usually I go to the seaside. Last summer I was in Spain. This summer I'm going to Greece. I'm going to swim and eat tasty food there. I will travel by plane. Yes, I like to travel. On the way you can read, draw or sleep. In summer I go camping with my friends.
5-s103.answer: Ответы: где обычно, где был прошлым летом, куда собираешься, что будешь делать, как поедешь, любишь ли путешествовать.

6-s103.condition: Unit 7, Step 7, упр. 6, с. 103. Расскажи о своих летних каникулах по примеру в учебнике.
steps: I like summer holidays. Usually I visit my grandparents in Sochi. I swim in the sea all day and eat fruit. Last summer I travelled to Istanbul with my parents — it's a beautiful old city. This summer I'm going to the seaside again.
6-s103.answer: Рассказ: usually (Present Simple) → last summer (Past Simple) → this summer (be going to).

7-s104.condition: Unit 7, Step 7, упр. 7, с. 104. Напиши словарный диктант.
steps: country, decide, holiday, invite, join, people, place, talk, tomorrow, travel.
7-s104.answer: country, decide, holiday, invite, join, people, place, talk, tomorrow, travel

8-s104.condition: Unit 7, Step 7, упр. 8, с. 104. Проект: напиши, чем любит заниматься твоя семья на выходных в разное время года.
steps: My family is very active. In winter we spend our weekends skiing or skating and making snowmen. In spring we go to our dacha and work in the garden. In summer we swim in the lake and have picnics. In autumn we usually stay at home, read books and watch films.
8-s104.answer: Рассказ «Our weekend» по временам года: winter — ski, skate; spring — dacha, garden; summer — swim, picnics; autumn — home, books, films.
